# AI Coding Tool Market Analysis

## Executive Summary

The AI coding assistant market has reached mainstream adoption, with 78% daily usage among professional developers (EV-001). Context-awareness is the top differentiator (EV-002).

## Market Adoption

AI coding assistants have achieved widespread adoption among professional developers. According to a 2026 industry survey, 78% of professional developers use AI coding assistants daily (EV-001). This represents a significant shift from just two years ago.

## Feature Preferences

Developer preferences center on context-awareness as the primary differentiator. Survey data indicates that developers rate context-awareness as the most important feature when choosing an AI coding tool (EV-002).

## Recommendations

Based on the adoption data (EV-001) and developer preference for context-awareness (EV-002), tools competing in this space should prioritize context window expansion and codebase-level understanding capabilities.
